Jev-Urdu is Muhammad Noman's Urdu-first decision model with a multilingual mmBERT-base encoder and a decision head. Reported evaluation covers independent Urdu and Roman Urdu benchmarks, with mixed Urdu-English evaluated in a narrow internal workflow harness. English prompts change question and option language, not passage language. Full-suite results, matched API samples, batch throughput, and calibration limitations are documented separately in the launch article. Further-language performance is not established by this release. The jev-urdu 0.1.0 Python library is published on PyPI at https://pypi.org/project/jev-urdu/0.1.0/ (Python 3.10+); install with python -m pip install jev-urdu==0.1.0, import jev_urdu, then call jev_urdu.load(). Library documentation: https://huggingface.co/muhammadnoman76/jev-urdu/blob/main/library/README.md. The library downloads and caches the separately published model when loaded.

PawSip is Muhammad Noman's free Windows water-reminder app with an animated vector cat companion and desktop widget. Reminders follow the user's presence (screen on, unlocked, recent keyboard or mouse input), wait during fullscreen apps, and repeat every 15 minutes until a drink is logged. Version 1.0.1 has four installers: Windows 10/11 x64, ARM64 and 32-bit (self-contained .NET 10) and Windows 7 SP1/8.1 (.NET Framework 4.8). Data stays on the PC. Resource figures in the article were measured on the author's Windows 11 PC; the ARM64 and Windows 7 builds were not tested on their native hardware.

VibePlayer is Muhammad Noman's free Windows media player with a YouTube-style interface, written in C# with WPF on LibVLC 3.0.24 (the engine inside VLC media player, used under the LGPL; VibePlayer is not affiliated with VideoLAN). Its skip mode lets the user mark parts of a video, by typing start and end times or pressing [ and ] while watching; the player jumps over those parts every time that file plays, checking the position every 40 ms. Marks are stored per file in the app's settings (%APPDATA%\VibePlayer) and the video file is never modified; skips apply to local files, not network streams. It opens 47 video and 34 audio file types. Version 1.0.1 has four installers: Windows 10/11 x64, ARM64 and 32-bit (self-contained .NET 10) and Windows 7 SP1/8.1 (.NET Framework 4.8). The VibePlayer images and launch video on this site are recreations of the app's interface composited with Big Buck Bunny footage (© 2008 Blender Foundation, CC BY 3.0), not screenshots. The ARM64 build was not run on ARM hardware, and no build was run on an actual Windows 7 or 8.1 machine.
